title: Flat tensor product commutes with cohomology of a bounded complex
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and let $C^\bullet$ be a bounded cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For every integer $i$, the canonical map $$H^i(C^\bullet)\otimes_A B\longrightarrow H^i(C^\bullet\otimes_A B)$$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 02KH, label lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, proof paragraph 'Since A -> B is flat, the same thing remains true on taking cohomology'

proof.text: For each degree $i$ write $Z^i=\ker(d^i)$, $B^i=\operatorname{im}(d^{i-1})$ and $H^i=Z^i/B^i$, so that $0\to Z^i\to C^i\xrightarrow{d^i}B^{i+1}\to 0$, $0\to B^{i+1}\to C^{i+1}$ and $0\to B^i\to Z^i\to H^i\to 0$ are exact. By the flat-tensor exactness lemma [lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact] (applied with $R=A$, $M=B$), all three stay exact after $-\otimes_A B$ (for the surjectivity apply it to $C^i\to B^{i+1}\to 0$, for the injections to $0\to Z^i\to C^i$, $0\to B^{i+1}\to C^{i+1}$, $0\to B^i\to Z^i$). Since $B^{i+1}\otimes_A B\to C^{i+1}\otimes_A B$ is injective, $d^i\otimes 1$ factors as the surjection $C^i\otimes_A B\to B^{i+1}\otimes_A B$ followed by an injection, so $\ker(d^i\otimes 1)=Z^i\otimes_A B$ and likewise $\operatorname{im}(d^{i-1}\otimes 1)=B^i\otimes_A B$ inside it. The third tensored sequence then identifies $H^i(C^\bullet\otimes_A B)=(Z^i\otimes_A B)/(B^i\otimes_A B)$ with $H^i\otimes_A B$. These identifications are induced by the canonical tensor maps, so they give the canonical isomorphism $H^i(C^\bullet)\otimes_A B\to H^i(C^\bullet\otimes_A B)$.

lean.note: The node is (C.sc i).mapHomologyIso (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A B)) for C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat A) ℤ, i : ℤ, with Algebra A B + Module.Flat A B encoding the flat ring map; the iso is the inverse direction H^i(C) ⊗_A B → H^i(C ⊗_A B). Its hypotheses are Mathlib instances: Module.Flat.instPreservesFiniteLimitsModuleCatTensorRightOfCarrier ([Module.Flat R M] : PreservesFiniteLimits (tensorRight M), Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.CategoryTheory), finite-colimit preservation of the left adjoint tensorRight M (Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Closed.Braided), hence Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact; HomologicalComplex.homology i is (C.sc i).homology by definition. Boundedness of C is not needed. Checked to elaborate by reviewer R-ftc0948.
